title: kbingest map lets a rustup cargo shim auto-install a pinned toolchain
goal: kbingest.NETWORK_OFF sets RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 so a rustup cargo proxy never installs an absent toolchain named by rust-toolchain.toml during map (rustup's user guide: default 1 installs the active toolchain when absent, 0 disables it); a test with a fake cargo asserts the variable reaches the command; agents/codebase-mapping.md carries the rustup fact with a DOC source row
